# Header macro argument copies and source lines

These complete canonical references were generated by pinned Joern v4.0.555. The four source-location probes retain all 1,184 AST/NODES/EDGES/FLOWS records and all 284 location records. A fifth quoted-literal guard retains another 284 canonical records and 73 location records. `expected.txt` removes only the `AST|` transport prefix; `locations.tsv` contains the additional metadata emitted by `oracle-locations.sc`.

The graph test compares every selected record. The location test compares every AST node in each `probe` method, including copied arguments, expansion nodes, and following assignments and sinks. Joern anchors macro descendants to the invocation line even when an actual argument spans later physical lines. Columns are retained as reference data; the production graph currently stores and exports line numbers only, so the test makes no column-parity claim.

Argument matching follows the pinned `MacroArgumentExtractor` and `MacroHandler.argForCode`: lexical tokens are joined into a lookup key, then ASCII spaces are removed from that key. Expansion node CODE is compared without further normalization. This deliberately preserves the existing omission of argument copies for spaced expansion expressions. Lookup normalization never rewrites the emitted literal: the fifth fixture keeps the space in `"a b"`, the escape in `"a\tb"`, and the space character literal unchanged.

The baseline failed both new tests: a multiline actual call lost its copied subtree, and macro descendants sometimes received physical argument lines instead of the invocation line. The following statements already had correct lines; these tests preserve them.
